director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj perimeter, yani boundary length, rectangles, squares aur polygons ka—cricket ground ki boundary jaisa. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Badhiya, Riya! Cricket ground ki boundary ke chaaron taraf chalne ki total distance ko perimeter kehte hain. Agar tum boundary round karo, kya naapogi?
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karni hai? Phir perimeter par wapas aayenge.
Theek hai, Riya—perimeter par wapas: polygon ki har side jodo. Cricket boundary ki chaar sides 20, 30, 20, 30 m hain; total kitna?
Riya, 20 plus 30 equals 50; phir 20 plus 30 equals 50; dono milkar 100 m. Agla step dekhna hai?
Chalo game: main ek polygon bolungi, tum uski sides ginna. Pehla polygon triangle hai—uski kitni sides hoti hain, Riya?
Triangle ki 3 sides hoti hain. Har side 5 units ho, toh perimeter ke liye 5 ko teen baar jodo—total kitna, Riya?
Yeh boring lag raha hai—style badalte hain: picture, story, ya game mein se ek choose karo. Riya, kya choose karogi?
Riya, kaunsa choose karogi: Picture dikhao, Kahani mein batao, ya Game khelte hain?
Riya, park ka ek round perimeter tha: 2 × (50 + 30) = 160 m; teen rounds ke liye— Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
Theek hai, Riya—tum rukna chahti ho. Choose karo: continue karein, short break lein, ya aaj ke liye stop karein?
